''See also: [[Bleeding Phoenix Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is a [[Dreadgod]] characterized by its composition of liquid blood and [[hunger madra]]. It possesses a unique biological cycle where it disperses fragments known as [[Blood Shadows]] across the world; these [[hunger spirits]] serve to steal power from hosts and return it to [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]], eventually allowing it to reconstruct its body. While [[Monarchs]] can temporarily destroy its physical form, the entity possesses a regenerative nature that allows it to reform. Its appearance is often described as a massive, crimson, semi-liquid bird that can span entire horizons. The entity is supported by the [[Redmoon Hall]], a cult of scavengers and subordinates that attend to its needs. [[The Phoenix]]'s awakening is often unpredictable, frequently catching [[sacred artists]] by surprise and causing widespread devastation through its presence, red lightning, and the release of [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]]. Beyond its role as a predator, there are indications of a restorative function associated with [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]], though this is limited to returning things to a previous state of order rather than creating new rules. The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] also maintains connections to other [[Dreadgods]], referring to them as siblings.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is a [[Dreadgod]] whose consciousness is scattered across thousands of fragments, some of which are sought out by a dedicated cult. Resting hundreds of miles to the south beneath a city of tattered cloth, this entity can be alerted if its seal is breached. The [[Dreadgod]] was eventually awakened by the presence of power within the same [[labyrinth]] containing a [[hunger madra]] [[binding]] and the [[Ancestor's Spear]]. This massive event was not predicted until only weeks before it occurred, resulting in the entity spreading its wings like a wound from one horizon to another. Consequently, the rise of the Bleeding [[Phoenix]] forced the closure of [[Arelius family|Arelius]] branches in the south, even as the entity offered mercy.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Originally established as a cult by the [[Blood Sage]], the Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is also identified as a massive [[Dreadgod]] capable of spanning an entire horizon. Although founded by the [[Sage]], the entity operates without his influence, receiving stolen power brought back by the [[Blood Shadow]]. This name serves as a symbol on [[Redmoon Hall]]'s [[cloudship]] and is recognized by the [[Sage of Red Faith]] as a specific lineage or group. As an influential organization, its continued existence may eventually face extermination by [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is a phenomenon characterized by an enhanced [[Blood aura|blood aura]] that causes the sky to blaze red, an event [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] survived during a rampage. While witnessed within the [[Blackflame Empire]], the entity was also observed flying into the [[Trackless Sea]]. [[Akura Malice]], who had faced the phenomenon before, managed to keep it away from specific areas for several days. During its presence in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], [[Eithan]] conducted experiments on the entity, which exhibited behavioral deviations and acted according to an unknown purpose. The arrival of the phenomenon also scared away individuals attempting to depart through [[Heaven's Glory|Heaven’s Glory]], and it was a location where [[Yerin]] might have thrown herself.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is a [[Dreadgod]] composed of blood and [[madra]] with an oozing red body. Born from the [[bone ring]], this entity possesses a scattered awareness that feels like a council within its mind. It is characterized by a sense of [[hunger]], corruption, and death, and it has the ability to call down a rain of red lightning. The creature can also use spatial distortion to dissolve its form into droplets that function as eggs. Despite being an event that [[Akura Malice]] failed to foresee, [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]] eventually emitted a keening cry and fled.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] is a [[Dreadgod]] composed of blood and [[hunger aspects]] that flies east through the [[Trackless Sea]] for [[Iceflower]]. This phoenix is a creature of horror stories whose aura stains the clouds with crimson stripes, and it possesses the ability to exert pressure on others through its song. While traveling across an entire continent alone, the entity maintains contact with [[Redmoon]] and appears to be bleeding because it keeps other aspects trapped in semi-gelatinous spheres. During a confrontation, the creature produces a tiny avatar made of blood with a liquid beak, only for the [[Sage of Red Faith]] to unleash everything into it.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Bleeding [[Phoenix]] serves as a source of [[madra]] within [[Yerin]], though she initially denied its will. While the [[Monarchs]] ensure its survival, this entity possesses a song and could serve as a perfect weapon for [[Yerin]]. It has begun consuming the people of [[Emriss Silentborn]], with its eggs merging into humans, animals, [[sacred beasts]], and trees. Capable of taking the form of a red-haired woman with scarlet wings, the entity's power is sensed like a crimson bonfire and its [[core binding]] resembles a sealed egg. During a massive battle felt by all sufficiently advanced people in the world, it attacked [[Lindon]] with ten thousand needles and a barrage of [[Striker techniques]]. Although its cloak swallowed [[Li Markuth]]'s sword, the tide of the fight tilted toward [[Lindon]] after [[Shen]] was gone, leading the entity to retaliate against [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]].}}
